notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware backend exists and no hardware run is claimed. Only the card's discrete entry symbol (MullerBrownDiscreteEnv / MullerBrownDiscrete-v0) is served; the card's second entry symbol, MullerBrownContinuousEnv, is a separate environment and is not modelled. The upstream clone is a legacy gym environment and package code never imports or installs it: the fake backend is the package's own pure Python re-implementation of the discrete class (fake.py) and was not compared with the upstream environment; the sim backend (gymnasium.make) was not run. The fake's reset(seed=...) is an extension of the upstream reset(), so seeded repeatability is a property of the fake; the fidelity contract says this and declares F0, timestep_ms 0, realtime_factor 0 and lockstep. Warnings are the family's expected ones: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only stores the seed for the next reset, so it makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived integer inputs (reset seed, seed seed, action.index, ticks). There are no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. Only catalogue classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest line the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
